findings.where: workspace-framework Req 7.2 / screen-snapshot-scrm Req 30.2 vs Req 29.1 and design Section 13 fixture
findings.problem: The window-title-bar leading marker differs across places: 7.2/30.2 show brand token + '_ [] X' with no leading marker, 29.1 shows a '# |' marker, the design fixture shows '| #  '. All three are explicitly SETTLED-BUT-TUNABLE, so it is presentation, not a contract conflict.
findings.fix: Add a one-line note in Req 30.2 that the exact leading glyph follows 29.1's tunable marker, so 7.2/30.2 are not read as forbidding the '# |' marker 29.1 permits.

findings.problem: The fixture status line clips the Alias Kind example segment mid-phrase ('... Aliases: 1 | Rows 1'); since per-Kind segment content is deferred (7.21/30.10), the clipped text is only illustrative but could be misread as literal required text.
findings.fix: Annotate the fixture that the Alias segment text is illustrative and its content is defined by the Alias follow-up Kind gate.

findings.problem: screen-snapshot-scrm Phase 2H correctly documents its dependency on Phase CF's Message_Line/last_action_at state, but Phase CF has no reverse pointer noting Phase 2H consumes that state. Navigability only; no correctness impact.
findings.fix: Add a one-line cross-reference in Phase CF noting screen-snapshot-scrm Phase 2H reproduces the Message_Line it introduces.
